summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Water and Sanitation Project Management for NGOs. Learn best practices to improve community health and sustainability.
lede: Water and sanitation project management helps NGO teams plan, coordinate, and monitor WASH projects from needs assessment through reporting. Designed for project officers, coordinators, engineers, programme managers, and MEAL staff, the course develops practical skills in assessment, work scheduling, procurement and site quality control, community engagement, risk management, and tracking results with indicators and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who manage or support NGO water and sanitation delivery and need practical tools to plan, coordinate, monitor, and report WASH projects more effectively.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop if possible, along with Excel or another spreadsheet tool for the dashboard exercises. You should also come prepared with one current or recent WASH project example, such as a proposal, logframe, site plan, donor report, or monitoring sheet.
